name: basis-phrases
description:
Each phrase that is a basis of the core, or an empty cell for the others: a basis holds no smaller phrase of the core.

A phrase is a basis when it is the first with its set of words and no other phrase of the core has some of its words only: «купить диван», «диван», «диван купить» → «», «диван», «». Words are compared in any case and with ё as е.
lemmas: compare the lemmas of the words («диваны» is «диван»).
stopwords: on, the stopwords count; off (--no-stopwords), they are left out of the comparison, and a phrase of stopwords only keeps them.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "диван" --text "диван купить" basis-phrases write -
-> купить диван, ; диван, диван; диван купить,

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_basis.

options.name: --lemmas
options.description: compare the lemmas of the words («диваны» is «диван»).

options.name: --stopwords
options.description: on, the stopwords count; off (--no-stopwords), they are left out of the comparison, and a phrase of stopwords only keeps them.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
